name: Docker Manager
description: Engine status, containers, images, volumes and Compose projects in one place: start, stop, restart, inspect logs, prune and install Docker Engine on the NAS. The engine helper and the /api/docker endpoints stay in EthOS because the package runtime depends on them; this package is the desktop app.
author: SyncHot
changelog: 1.0.1: Package Center icon redrawn on the 256 px grid; requires EthOS 2.0. 1.0.0: first release. The Docker Manager desktop app moves out of the core install; the Docker Engine helper, the compose runtime and the /api/docker endpoints stay in EthOS because every container package depends on them.
